label: In every accessible history at every moment, an efficient cause is PRIOR_1 to its effect
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history accessible from the selected world and at every moment, whatever is then and there an efficient cause of x in some respect is simply prior to x (the single unindexed frame relation PriorSimply). It is the all-histories, all-moments version of e078f07b; the Aquinas claim on e078f07b does not extend to it.
